name: Paper God: Daoist Goddess Who Cures Smallpox
summary: 哈佛艺术博物馆著录：Chinese；early 20th century；Woodblock print; ink on paper; with printed inscription reading from right to left: "Dou Zhen Niangniang" ("Smallpox Goddess"). Probably from Beijing; part of a possible set of paper gods 1935.36.62-.81.
